headline: Another company has applied to trademark the name of the AI-made meme Tung Tung Tung Sahur for toys, adding to a fight over who owns the character.
score_reason: Pool score 3 lowered by 1: the filing was published on 15 Sep 2026 and the extension was granted soon after, so this is older news reported late, with no ruling.
importance_line: What changed: a second party is seeking rights to the character's name for toys, which affects the creator's agency and anyone who sells merchandise; a name filing does not settle who owns the character, and nothing has been decided.
summary: The Mary Sue reports that Innovatex Labs LLC has applied to register the name Tung Tung Tung Sahur as a US trademark for toys, an application the US Patent and Trademark Office published for opposition on 15 Sep 2026, and that Mementum, the agency representing the character's creator, has until 13 Jan 2027 to oppose it, according to the office's docket. In our 7 Oct 2026 edition we carried The Guardian's report on a separate lawsuit over whether the AI-made character can be copyrighted at all, and neither dispute has been settled.
notes: Underlying filings date from 15 Sep 2026 (publication) and late Sep (extension); this is new coverage of older events plus a link to our 7 Oct 2026 story. Editor may hold it as older news re-dated.
